verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only Microsoft Graph's proprietary REST mail API. Nothing shows Outlook offering IMAP, JMAP or SMTP access, or a standards-based export. MIME appears only as a send format inside Graph's sendMail call, and the only export path cited is a community workaround that converts .pst to mbox with the third-party readpst utility. Neither counts as the product's own open-protocol access or standard export.

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in
